title: Background Remover Pro
shortDescription: Create stunning, studio quality cutouts in seconds with powerful AI and complete on device privacy.
description:
Background Remover Pro is a professional, easy-to-use Windows utility for automatically removing image backgrounds with AI. Images are processed locally on your device and are not uploaded to the publisher for processing.

Choose an image, select the most suitable detection model, and create a transparent PNG in moments. For difficult edges, use Alpha Matting and fine-tune feathering, mask contraction, or expansion. Replace the removed area with transparency, a solid color, or a custom background image.

Batch processing lets you process multiple images and save results to one folder. Local history keeps recent results easy to find. The selected AI model may be downloaded from the internet on first use and cached on your device. No account is required, and exported images contain no watermark.
features: Solid color or custom background replacement
benefits: Remove backgrounds without uploading images to the publisher
Refine difficult edges with Alpha Matting controls
Process multiple images and save results to one folder
Export clean transparent PNG files for reuse
